Exit Load 0.2% Lock In No Lock-in TurnOver 27.72% Risk Very High Risk About SBI Large Cap Fund SBI Bluechip Fund is a large-cap mutual fund that invests in the top 100 companies ranked on the stock exchange by their market capitalization. The fund invests at least 80% of its assets in large-cap stocks . The remaining 20% is invested in REITs, debt instruments and money market instruments. SBI Bluechip Direct Growth Fund maintains a strong focus on industries like Finance, Automobile, FMCG, Technology, Energy, etc. The fund managers follow a mix of growth and value style investing to pick stocks for the bluechip fund. This includes picking stocks that are expected to grow faster than others and are undervalued. NAV or Net Asset Value is the per unit price of a mutual fund. For example, if the NAV of a fund is ₹10, it means you can get 1000 units of that mutual fund at ₹10,000. What is the return on the fund? SBI Large Cap Fund fund has generated a return of 4.18% in 1 year, 10.97% in 3 years, 10.92% in 5 years. Who is the fund manager of SBI Large Cap Fund? The fund managers are Saurabh Pant. What is the exit load of the fund? The exit load is 0.25% if redeemed in 0-30 Days, 0.1% if redeemed in 30-90 Days. Exit load is a fee levied for ‘exiting’ the fund earlier than a stipulated period, usually 1 year. What is the expense ratio of the fund? The expense ratio is 0.85%.
